title: 5 Catering Ideas That Will Sparkle at Your Holiday Party
summary: At Instawork we have the pleasure of supporting thousands of talented caterers and culinary professionals across the country. Here are some stand out ways to add some sparkle into your catering creations for upcoming holiday parties.
body_markdown:
At[Instawork](https://www.instawork.com/) we have the pleasure of supporting thousands of talented caterers and culinary professionals across the country. The beauty of building relationships with caterers is that we're able to witness the special experiences and magic that they create for their clients. Recently, we also welcomed[Mark Wallace](https://www.instawork.com/blog/welcome-mark-wallace-as-chief-financial-officer) as our Chief Financial Officer. If you're looking to enhance your catering services, check out our[Webinar: Optimize your staff for campus dining success](https://www.instawork.com/webinars/optimize-your-staff-for-campus-dining-success) .


The holidays are a memorable and special time of year and we know it's important to create a 'wow' experience your guests in an elegant yet unique way. Here are some stand out ways to add some sparkle into your catering creations for upcoming holiday parties:


## Sushi Plate of Candy


### Peached Tortilla Catering


**Instagram Account:**[@peachedtortillacatering](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bpm5gCnlNwC/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link)


Talk about sugar rush! We love how Peached Tortilla took a sweet twist on the traditional sushi plate. Long gone are the days of candy canes and traditional gingerbread houses displayed on a dessert table. Food is meant to be fun and this is one way to surprise and delight your guests as they get ready to indulge!


## Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup


### Conceptually Social — Unique Corporate Catering


**Instagram Account:**[@conceptuallysocialcatering](https://www.instagram.com/p/BertAu7HXAs/)


Remember the childhood classic of grilled cheese and tomato soup on a cold winter day? Stir up some true nostalgia while keeping your guests warm with this delicious creation by Conceptually Social. These tomato soup cups topped with a mini grilled cheese make the perfect appetizer for your guests and are guaranteed to be loved by kids and adults alike. For more insights on catering trends, read our article on[Wanted: 100k New Pros This Holiday Season](https://www.instawork.com/blog/wanted-100k-new-pros-this-holiday-season) .


Bonus: No utensils are required for this hors d'oeuvre!


## Very Merry Bar Cart


### Annie Campbell — Catering, Party Planning + Event Design


**Instagram Account:**[@annielcampbell](https://www.instagram.com/p/Brq_vttl2Yt/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link)


What's better than a bar at your holiday party, you ask? A rolling bar cart! Create an unforgettable experience for your guests with a very merry mobile drink station.


Annie Campbell spruced up the classic holiday drink set up on a beautiful and timeless bar cart. The good news about this bar ( *aside from it being some serious eye candy for your guests* ) is that you can place it anywhere in your event. Eliminate bringing in bulky bars that are tough to set up and break down.


Pro tip: Add some mistletoe or boughs of holly to get your guests in the holiday spirit.


## Eggnog With a Tequila Twist


### Bon Appeteach — Certified Culinary Arts Teacher


**Instagram Account:**[@bonappeteach](https://www.instagram.com/bonappeteach/)


Speaking of bars, we adore this twist on the classic holiday drink, Eggnog. @bonappeteach takes a genius approach on revamping this traditional creamy and bourbon forward drink for the holiday season by adding tequila as an ingredient to this cocktail.


If you needed an added bonus, this smoked horchata eggnog cocktail can be made with low carb ingredients which makes it keto-friendly for your health-conscious guests.[Check out the full recipe by Bon Appeteach](https://www.bonappeteach.com/a-wrinkle-in-tequila-smoked-horchata-eggnog-cocktail/#.XcogeJL0kdY) .


## Festive Mini Tacos


### Urban Palate — Boutique Catering Company


**Instagram Account:**[@urbanpalatela](https://www.instagram.com/p/BSHkSrllLMO/?utm_source=ig_web_options_share_sheet)


Taco bout a good time! We're digging this twist on a classic fan favorite of tacos! We love how Urban Palate added some holiday spice to this appetizer with red festive taco shells. Plus, securing these tacos in dried beans is a unique way to add some texture and a stunning visual to your food presentation.


Have more ideas on how to make your holiday party sparkle? Leave us a comment below with your favorite catering ideas for the season.
